note: The effect text of each gift the settings GUI shows (gift_search.json's, then gift_recipes.json's fusion gifts, materials, extra gifts and vestiges), as the game's gift panel prints it. English: the game client 1.119.0's EN_EGOgift_*.json desc; Chinese: the Localize Limbus Company release's LLC_zh-CN/EGOgift_*.json desc (Simplified Chinese), by gift id. Each text is a list of runs: a string is plain text; {"kw": id} a [tag] that names a keyword, drawn as its icon and its name in its colour; {"text", "i", "colour"} italic or coloured text (flavour text). keywords: each keyword the texts name: its name in each language (Bufs*.json, BattleKeywords*.json of each), its colour as the client's ColorCode table names it (its buff's buffType in the static data buff/*.json) and its icon (gui/src/buf_icons/<icon>.webp, tools/buf_icons.py). A bracketed note that names no keyword stays as written. The Chinese converted with OpenCC s2twp run by run, then 指標->指針, 重新整理->刷新, 映象->鏡像, 透過階層->通過階層, 松肉->鬆肉.
